title: USDA's FoodData Central: what is it and why is it needed today?
authors: Fukagawa NK, McKillop K, Pehrsson PR, Moshfegh A, Harnly J, Finley J
funder: All authors are employed by the USDA Agricultural Research Service and have not received external support in the preparation of this manuscript.
authorConflicts: The authors report no conflicts of interest.
result: FoodData Central SR Legacy items, per 100 g, read 2026-10-21 at https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/portal-data/external/<FDC ID>. Oil, soybean, salad or cooking (171411): PUFA 18:2 n-6 c,c 50.4 g; PUFA 18:3 n-3 c,c,c (ALA) 6.79 g. Oil, canola (172336): 18:2 n-6 c,c 18.6 g; ALA 9.14 g; total monounsaturated 63.3 g. Oil, corn, industrial and retail, all purpose salad or cooking (171029): 18:2 n-6 c,c 53.2 g; ALA 1.16 g. Oil, safflower, salad or cooking, linoleic, (over 70%) (171026): PUFA 18:2 74.6 g, a manufacturer-supplied analytical value with incomplete documentation. Oil, sunflower, linoleic, (approx. 65%) (171025): PUFA 18:2 65.7 g. Oil, sunflower, high oleic (70% and over) (172338): PUFA 18:2 3.61 g. SR Legacy, released in 2018, is the final release of that data type.
